welcome.title: Welcome to Kaitech
welcome.body: Sign in with your Kaitech account to continue.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.body: Enter your server address. You'll sign in on your server's own page, so this app never sees your password.
signIn.databaseHint: Leave this empty if your server has only one database.
signIn.continueHint: Opens your server's sign-in page in the browser

errors.serverInvalid: That doesn't look like a server address.
errors.serverInsecure: The server must use a secure connection (https).
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and the address, then try again.
errors.accessDenied: Sign-in on this device was declined.
errors.stateMismatch: The sign-in response didn't match this request. Please try again.
errors.codeExpired: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Please sign in again.
errors.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.server: The server ran into a problem. Please try again later.
errors.unsupported: This server doesn't support the Kaitech app yet.
errors.linkNotConfigured: This build can't finish signing in because its sign-in link domain isn't set up.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.accountNotTeam: This account can't use the Kaitech app.
errors.accountInactive: This account is no longer active.

wizard.languageBody: You can change this any time in Settings.
wizard.lockBody: Ask for {{method}} when you come back to Kaitech after 5 minutes away.

lock.title: Kaitech is locked
lock.failed: Couldn't confirm it's you. Please try again.
lock.unavailable: Set up a screen lock on this device first.

tabs.comingBody: This part of the app is still being built.

settings.title: Settings
settings.signOutBody: This device is removed from your account and stops getting its notifications.
settings.signOutOffline: You're signed out here. This device may stay listed in your account until you remove it on the web.

expired.title: Your session has ended
expired.body: Sign in again to keep using {{server}}.

errors.forbidden: Your account can't open this. Ask the programme lead for access.
errors.refused: The server didn't accept this. Refresh and try again.
errors.server: The server ran into a problem. Please try again later.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.key_invalid: This question couldn't be sent. Please try again.
errors.key_conflict: This question was already sent with different words. Send it again as a new question.
errors.conversation_invalid: This conversation is no longer available.
errors.conversation_not_found: This conversation is no longer available.
errors.programme_invalid: This programme is no longer available.
errors.programme_not_found: This programme is no longer available.
errors.coworker_retired: This programme's Coworker is no longer active.
errors.ask_refused: The Coworker can't take this question in this conversation.
errors.agree_invalid: That answer couldn't be recorded. Please try again.
errors.card_invalid: This card is no longer available.
errors.card_not_found: This card is no longer available.
errors.card_refused: This card isn't yours to answer.

home.noneBody: Programmes you are part of appear here.
home.evidenceAndFindingsBody: Quotes from interviews, documents and meetings

thread.title: Coworker
thread.emptyTitle: Ask the Coworker anything about this programme
thread.emptyBody: Answers come from the programme record, with the evidence behind them.
thread.failed: The Coworker could not finish this answer.
thread.waitingForYou: The Coworker is waiting for your answer

card.title: Decision card
card.saidBack: What {{name}} said, as the Coworker understood it
card.replyHint: Reply to the Coworker in the conversation to decide this card.

finding.title: Finding
finding.askPrefill: Explain the finding "{{name}}" and its evidence.
finding.noneBody: Findings appear once the Coworker compares the evidence.

evidence.noneBody: Evidence appears after interviews, documents or meetings are added.

activity.noneBody: Cards and questions for you appear here.

search.noneBody: Try other words, or ask the Coworker.
search.hintBody: Messages, Discovery and meetings in one place.

mom.noneBody: Meetings you record appear here with their minutes.

setup.title: Record a meeting
setup.consent: Everyone in the meeting agreed to be recorded
setup.consentHint: This agreement is noted on the meeting before the recording is uploaded.
setup.consentKnown: Participants' consent is already noted for this meeting.
setup.noMeetings: No earlier meetings in this programme.
setup.denied: Kaitech needs the microphone to record. Allow it in Settings.
setup.failed: The recording couldn't start. Please try again.
setup.noProgramme: You aren't in any programme yet, so there is nowhere to file a recording.
setup.consentNeeded: Confirm that everyone agreed to be recorded.

mom.consentNote: Participants agreed to the recording (confirmed in the Kaitech app at {{time}}).

recorder.discardBody: Everything recorded so far is deleted from this phone.
recorder.stopBody: The recording is saved and uploads in the background.

upload.sending: {{size}} · {{percent}} · continues by itself if the signal drops
upload.signedOut: Sign in to this account again to continue
upload.done: Uploaded. Minutes are written from it next.
upload.discardBody: The file is deleted from this phone and its upload is cancelled.

errors.file_missing: the file is no longer on this phone
errors.upload_failed: storage didn't receive the whole file
errors.recording_duplicate: this programme already holds the same file
errors.upload_not_open: the upload was closed on the server
errors.part_refused: storage refused part of the file
errors.parts_invalid: storage refused part of the file
errors.parts_missing: part of the file is missing
errors.forbidden: your account may not upload here
errors.consent_missing: the meeting has no recording consent
errors.meeting_invalid: the meeting is no longer available
errors.meeting_not_found: the meeting is no longer available
errors.programme_invalid: the programme is no longer available
errors.programme_not_found: the programme is no longer available
errors.file_too_large: the file is larger than 2 GB
errors.key_conflict: the upload key belongs to another upload
errors.recording_invalid: the recording is no longer available
errors.recording_not_found: the recording is no longer available
errors.server: the server ran into a problem

detail.unverified: Written by the Coworker, not yet checked by a person.
detail.tapToHear: Tap an item to hear that part of the recording.
detail.notYetBody: They appear here once the recording is transcribed and the minutes are written.
detail.closedBody: Ask the programme lead for access.
detail.noItems: No items were found in this meeting.
detail.pick: Choose a meeting to read its minutes.

final.signBody: Signing locks the text of the minutes. Making them final and sharing them stays on the web.
final.notReady: These minutes can't be signed yet.
final.awaiting_one: {{count}} item still waits for review on the web.
final.awaiting_other: {{count}} items still wait for review on the web.
final.drift: The minutes changed after they were signed.
final.empty: The final minutes aren't ready yet.
